Path to the compiled VBA project

ck_vba_project_path.Rd

Locates cleaningkit_vba.bin, the compiled VBA project injected into macro-enabled cleaning logs. Returns "" when it cannot be found.

Usage

ck_vba_project_path()

Value

A file path, or "" if the VBA project cannot be found.

Details

The search order is:

  1. getOption("cleaningkit.vba_project");

  2. the CLEANINGKIT_VBA_PROJECT environment variable;

  3. inst/extdata of the installed package;

  4. inst/extdata/, resources/, functions/, dev/ and the working directory itself.

Steps 1 and 4 exist because these functions are often sourced straight into an analysis project rather than used from the installed package. In that situation system.file() returns "" - and it also returns "" when the package is installed but was installed before the binary was built, which is easy to miss. Dropping the .bin into the project (resources/ is a natural home) or setting the option in a setup script both work:


options(cleaningkit.vba_project = "C:/path/to/cleaningkit_vba.bin")

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ck_vba_project_path()
} # }
